description: Regions built by scripts/build_world.py. area: lon0, lat0, lon1, lat1 searched; countries: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes (Natural Earth ISO_A2_EH) whose land is kept, in the order they win where zones meet; exclude: coast files of countries drawn by other means, whose land is cut away; dem: heightmap built for the area (tile zoom, pixels per degree); unlock: what the new countries in the registry need for now.
